author: Mark Atwood
text: OVERLAP: MIME-72l.62 (review) covers the same walk.rs Option<&mut Vec> pattern from the opposite direction — documents why the double-indirection is correct per RFC 8621 §4.1.4 pseudocode. Fix team should handle deduplication; MIME-72l.34 is labeled opinion because MIME-72l.62 provides a documented engineering rationale for the current design.
